chore: rebrand openclaw-worker → Sigilix (visible-surface rename)

## Summary

Sigilix is the new product name. Tagline: *"The mark of merge-ready code."*

Pre-rename PR — must land **before** clicking Rename in the GitHub App settings AND on the repository, otherwise the deployed Worker silently ignores webhooks from the new bot login.

## What this PR rebrands (visible surfaces)

- Worker name in `wrangler.toml`: `openclaw-worker` → `sigilix`
- `package.json` name + description
- README header, branding, naming history section
- `DEFAULT_TRIGGERS` in `src/lib/mention.ts`: add `sigilix` variants while keeping every legacy alias (`arc`, `arc-copilot`, `openclaw`) so historical PR threads with @-mentions of the old names still trigger
- `isBotHandle()` second arm: `sigilix` added to bare-handle list (covers Linear OAuth display name when no `[bot]` suffix is appended)
- `isArcGithubLogin()` regex: `sigilix` added (function name kept for back-compat with imports across the codebase)
- `scripts/phase4-bakeoff.mjs`: replaced hardcoded `"arc-copilot[bot]"` filter with a `SELF_BOT_LOGINS` set that accepts `sigilix[bot]` AND every legacy alias, so historical bake-off data remains comparable across the rename boundary
- Test fixtures + new sigilix coverage in `tests/mention.test.ts` and `tests/arc-in-thread-above.test.ts`

## What this PR does NOT touch (deferred operational migration)

- Cloudflare KV namespace ID, Vectorize index name (`openclaw-code-index`), Queue name (`openclaw-jobs`) — renaming requires data migration
- Env var prefixes (`OPENCLAW_*`, e.g., `OPENCLAW_MENTION_TRIGGERS`, `OPENCLAW_STATE` binding) — internal infra, ~100 references in code, cosmetic-only change, breaking deploy without value
- Dedupe markers (`<!-- openclaw:pr-review -->`, `<!-- openclaw:pr-overview -->`) — content-based dedupe; changing them would post duplicate comments on existing PRs

## Sequencing for the actual rebrand (post-merge)

1. Merge this PR
2. Deploy: `wrangler deploy` — creates a new Worker named `sigilix` on the Cloudflare account (old `openclaw-worker` Worker stays alive until manually deleted)
3. Update GitHub App webhook URL to point at the new sigilix Worker
4. Update Linear webhook URL to point at the new sigilix Worker
5. Click Rename in GitHub App settings: `arc-copilot` → `sigilix`
6. Click Rename on the GitHub repo: `openclaw-worker` → `Sigilix`
7. Update wrangler routes / Cloudflare Pages domain bindings if/when `sigilix.[tld]` custom domain is purchased via Vercel
8. Delete the old `openclaw-worker` Worker after a 7-day cooldown

## Tests

- 455 tests passing on this branch (all existing + 5 new sigilix trigger-coverage assertions in `tests/mention.test.ts` and `tests/arc-in-thread-above.test.ts`).
- Typecheck clean.

## Test plan

- [x] All existing tests pass on the branch
- [x] New trigger tests for sigilix variants pass
- [x] `isBotHandle("Sigilix[bot]")` returns true; `isBotHandle("danny")` returns false
- [x] `arcInThreadAbove` with `sigilix[bot]` parent returns true (implicit-mention reply works under new brand)
- [x] Bake-off harness `SELF_BOT_LOGINS` set covers both old and new logins so historical reviews remain matchable
- [ ] Post-merge: verify deployed Worker accepts both `arc-copilot[bot]` (legacy) and `sigilix[bot]` (new) webhook events during the GitHub App rename window

Closes ARC-157.
